summary: Completed backend-only testing for Gracefy API after modular router refactoring. All 27 tests passed (100% success rate). The refactoring from monolithic 13,988 line server.py to modular router architecture with ~300 lines in server.py and 16 modular router files was successful - all endpoints are working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api - Returns API info with endpoints list (v3.0.0)
GET /api - Contains endpoints information for auth, music, home, layout, churches, choirs, bible, payment, admin
GET /api/health - Contains cache_type info (memory fallback since Redis not available)
GET /api/analytics/overview - Contains expected fields (total_users: 4, total_songs: 21, total_albums: 11)
GET /api/song-categories - Categories have expected structure (name, color, icon)
GET /api/albums - Albums have expected structure (album_id, title, artist_name)
GET /api/user/search - Returns songs, albums, choirs, churches categories
GET /api/user/search - Correctly requires 'q' parameter (returns 422 without it)
GET /api/subscription-plans - Plans have expected structure (plan_id, name, price)
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Modular router architecture successfully implemented with 16 router files
✓ All routers properly exported from routes/__init__.py
✓ server.py reduced from ~14,000 lines to ~300 lines (clean application factory pattern)
✓ Health check endpoint includes cache status and traffic monitoring
✓ MongoDB connection and cache initialization working correctly
✓ Redis fallback to in-memory cache working as expected
✓ All CRUD operations for core entities (albums, songs, choirs, churches) functional
✓ Search endpoint properly validates required parameters
✓ Layout sections and subscription plans endpoints working correctly
